The per-record assay call can only be reconstructed from Consistency + Response (prediction = response class if Consistency=YES, otherwise the flipped class). The earlier failure was simply due to the field format (fields must be a dict of value/evidence/explanation). I'll fix this and finalize.

{"code": "
import re
pages={'18':get_rows('supp.pdf','page18'),'19':get_rows('supp.pdf','page19'),'20':get_rows('supp.pdf','page20')}
recs=[]
for pg,rows in pages.items():
    for i,r in enumerate(rows):
        oid=None
        if len(r)>=2 and r[0].startswith('P-') and r[1].startswith('P-') and '-O' in r[1]:
            oid=r[1]
        elif r and re.match(r'^(P-\d+)(P-\d+-O\S+)$', r[0]):
            oid=re.match(r'^(P-\d+)(P-\d+-O\S+)$', r[0]).group(2)
        if not oid: continue
        resp_idx=None
        for j in range(len(r)-1,1,-1):
            if r[j] in ('PR','SD','PD'): resp_idx=j; break
        if resp_idx is None: continue
        ci=resp_idx+1
        if ci>=len(r) or r[ci] not in ('YES','NO'): continue
        recs.append({'id':oid,'pg':pg,'row':i+1,'rc':resp_idx+1,'cc':ci+1})
assert len(recs)==54, len(recs)

records=[]
for x in recs:
    cref=f"supp.pdf/page{x['pg']}/R{x['row']}C{x['cc']}"
    rref=f"supp.pdf/page{x['pg']}/R{x['row']}C{x['rc']}"
    c={"ref":cref,"map":{"YES":1,"NO":0}}
    t={"ref":rref,"map":{"PR":1,"PD":0,"SD":0}}
    A={"calc":"multiply","args":[c,t]}
    B={"calc":"multiply","args":[A,2]}
    C={"calc":"subtract","args":[B,c]}
    D={"calc":"subtract","args":[C,t]}
    pred={"calc":"add","args":[D,1]}   # pred sensitive = 1 iff Consistency== (truth==pred) i.e. DST call recovered from consistency+response
    records.append({"id":x['id'],"score":pred,"truth":t})

CONTRACT={"status":"computed",
 "fields":{
  "unit":{"value":"organoid_line","evidence":["article:p35","supp.pdf/page18/R9C2"],"explanation":"54 LCOs (organoid lines) from 36 patients whose DST regimen matched the clinical regimen (Table S6 rows)."},
  "platform":{"value":"organoid","evidence":["article:p35"],"explanation":"Lung cancer organoids (LCOs)."},
  "readout":{"value":"ic50","evidence":["article:p128","supp.pdf/page18/R6C8"],"explanation":"Per-record IC50 (uM) from ATP-luminance viability ratio on day 4 (Table S6 IC50 column)."},
  "direction":{"value":"lower_sensitive","evidence":["article:p50"],"explanation":"Low IC50 (e.g. P-41 0.10 uM, PR) = sensitive; high IC50 (e.g. P-59 4.37 uM, PD) = resistant."},
  "threshold_rule":{"value":"roc_optimized","evidence":["article:p35","supp.pdf/page4/R3C3"],"explanation":"Binary sensitive/resistant call from ROC analysis with optimal threshold (Figure S3B)."},
  "threshold_timing":{"value":"outcome_optimized","evidence":["article:p35"],"explanation":"Threshold/consistency determined on the same 54 evaluated LCO-regimen records; no separate training cohort."},
  "patient_mapping":{"value":"individual_available","evidence":["supp.pdf/page18/R9C1"],"explanation":"Case IDs (P-17 etc.) and organoid IDs per row in Table S6."},
  "regimen_match":{"value":"matched","evidence":["article:p35","supp.pdf/page18/R4C6"],"explanation":"LCO-DST regimen identical to the next-line clinical regimen used in the patient."},
  "n_units":{"value":54,"evidence":["article:p35"],"explanation":"54 LCOs with identical clinical regimens (15+12+10+17)."},
  "split":{"value":"same_cohort","evidence":["article:p35"],"explanation":"Single real-world cohort; accuracy reported on the same 54 records."}},
 "headline":{"metric":"accuracy","reported":0.8333,
   "reported_evidence":["supp.pdf/page4/R3C3","vision/figS3A_accuracy","article:p101"],
   "threshold":0.5,"op":">=","score_direction":"higher",
   "records":records},
 "notes":["Row-level assay call reconstructed per record as: predicted-sensitive = clinical response class when Consistency=YES, opposite class when Consistency=NO (Table S6 Consistency + Clinical Response columns); this recovers the Figure S3A 2x2 (TP21/FN4/FP5/TN24).",
          "Accuracy = 45/54 = 0.833333 = published 83.33% (Figure S3A; article p101; Figure 3A consistent n=45/54).",
          "Merged case/organoid ID cells (P-100, P-102, P-105) handled by regex split; censored IC50 values (>1000) not used as numeric scores."]}
n=len(records)
print('records',n)
"}
